buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 5. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NIL Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: As per Inspection Clause or authorized representative of Ed/OFBH 6. Non-compliance of above Terms & Conditions may result in termination of participation and offer of t he Firm will be liable for rejection. Bidder Undertaking I have read the clause mentioned in ATC in this bid and given compliance of the following clauses: 1) Specification 2) Delivery Period 3) Option Clause 4) Inspection Clause 5) Bidder Financial Standing 6) Non-Involvement in Cartel Formation: We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of car tel with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LI MITED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 7) Material: Pre inspection report, Guarantee/warranty certificate and Test Certificate should be sent alo ng with supply. The material will be checked by Govt. lab/NABL accredited lab and the resultsof the lab will be the sole criteria for acceptance of the item. 8) Loading/Unloading: Offer should be for Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. Unloading of Goods at OFBH pre mises will be done by the supplier. 9) Product Delivery: a. Each package/bags shall be suitable marked with identification marking to enable satisfact ory reference with the corresponding Invoice and GeM contract number. Marking on Each package/bags m ust contains reference Invoice number. GeM contract number, Qty, Item description, Outer dimension, vol ume and gross weight in Units should as per contract. If identification marking on each package/bags is no t available or not matching with reference Invoice Qty then firm is responsible delay to acceptance of mat erial or for any short supply. Every Gunny/Plastic/Packaging bag containing the material/component should be sufficient strength/strong enabling to bear standard way of handling and not to tear easily. b. Supplier must generate Physical Invoice Qty as per Lot wise Qty of stagger delivery period mention in respective contract. GeM invoice to be generated at time of delivery as per physical invoice Qty within delivery period. If supplier get any difficulties to generate the GeM Invoice within delivery period th en contact to GeM help desk to resolve the issue.

c. Each Consignment should be Supply with following documents in 1. Physical Tax Invoice 2. GeM Invoice copy (Qty should be matched with Tax Invoice Qty) 3. Test Report (NABL or as per GeM Contract T&C) 4. Guarantee/Warranty 5. Pre-Inspection Report d. In case of Supplier has failed to provide the above mentioned documents along with each Consignmen t then material will not be taken inside the Factory. 10) Guarantee/Warranty: The stores supplied against the order shall be deemed to have been warrante d by the contractor against deterioration/defective material and workmanship and performance for a perio d of 12 months from the date of receipt of stores at our end and any material found rejected/defective duri ng the Guarantee/Warranty period, the same should be replaced free of cost. 11) Payment Terms: Payment terms shall be 100% payment through NEFT/RTGS only for accepted mate rial within 30 days for the date of receipt of material or submission of bills/documents whichever is later. 12) Quantity Tolerance: Excess/short supplies not exceeding five percent of the original value of the con tract. Note: In case any query/information please contact to Provisioning section, Ordnance Factory Bhusawal at ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in or 02582-222552, 222907, Extn- 241 .
